decision: GO to seal and run broad qualification; no source correctness blocker found.
broad_qualification: PENDING: 76 focused commands, 978 cases / 9573 differential observations / 7656 native comparisons, 11484 standard host observations, and derived distinct module/input worker cases over 3828 aliases. Focused prechecks and factorial screens do not substitute for these gates.
scope: Final locked test sources, recorded clean focused executions, CI and matched-control qualification wiring. This review did not rerun tests.
strided_findings: Independent scalar oracle covers all eight signed/unsigned integer widths, exact low literal bits, logical checking before wrapped physical addressing, ordered writes, final cursor and i64 wrap. V8/Wasmtime and matched reference compare memory windows, traps and abort payload/line.

O0/O2 group boundaries, five strides, inclusive/unit/explicit-assignment updates, high pointers, short logical and physical spans, large strides and finite invalid/empty cases are exercised. Fixed/raw-owner frame/global positives and unchanged full Sieve output also have native or engine oracles.
Debug, captures/addresses, extra effects/calls/break and encoded/public-owner cases assert scalar body identity when the supplied matched reference is present.

The new eighth method compiles a closed raw-owner private function before adding a test-only export, asserts the CODE section is unchanged and confirms optimized O2 body difference. Thirteen layouts include header offsets -16 through +24, physical-tail faults and zero-trip forged pointers. Matching scalar-control outcomes directly exercise the raw header-disjointness guard; earlier nonraw forged-owner coverage is not conflated with it.
scan_findings: Independent oracle returns count, final cursor and last index, models exact i64 wrapping and debug overflow, and checks trap outcomes. Candidate/control comparisons also include abort details on both engines.

All 256 byte values, i8/u8 literal bits, stride masks 1/2/4/8, individual lane matches, skipped-lane matches, empty/full masks and wrapping count are covered. O0/O2 release/debug, vector boundaries, unaligned/high pointers, short logical/physical spans, literal and slice.len endpoints are included.

Body-equality negatives cover cursor/count/last aliases, changed bounds, address/capture exposure, extra effects/calls/reads, unsupported step, nonbyte type, explicit widening and reversed predicate. Native oracles cover fixed storage; owners remain scalar.

The clean result records 240 direct-Wasm compiles, 21320 engine cases, 10412 independent oracle checks and 120 body comparisons. The earlier ARG_MAX harness failure recorded zero engine cases and remains retained; it is not counted as coverage.
limits: Standalone CI without an optional frozen reference cannot perform reference body-equality checks; the broad qualification commands supply exact matched references.
Strided stores have no dedicated positive slice.len-bound fixture; that matcher remains statically reviewed. Scan has positive slice.len fixtures.
Memory oracles inspect declared relevant windows rather than every byte of memory. Raw-owner retargeting is checked by full recorded candidate/control outcomes rather than a fixed-view oracle.
Focused counts above are retained clean prechecks, not the pending broad qualification result.
